heroHeadline: Peña Nieto: Structural Reforms, Ayotzinapa, and the Collapse of PRI Hegemony
heroSubtitle: Six years of sweeping reforms undercut by Ayotzinapa impunity, Casa Blanca corruption, record homicides, and the gasolinazo — the legal reckoning intensifies into September 2026 as Gilda Lozoya wins a suspension in the Agronitrogenados case, Peña Nieto is photographed in Italy with an Israeli businessman accused of $25M in Pegasus-linked bribes, and Sheinbaum's government prepares a new Ayotzinapa report ahead of the 12th anniversary
footerNote: Data sourced from Diario Oficial, INEGI, CONEVAL, GIEI/IACHR, Proceso, Animal Político, Aristegui Noticias, MCCI, World Bank, Banxico, Transparency International
